normalize_img: normalize an image tensor using ImageNet mean and std to approximate [-1,1] range
unnormalize_img: unnormalize an image tensor back to [0,1] range using ImageNet mean and std
round_pixel: round pixel values of a normalized image tensor to the nearest integer and re-normalize
project_linf: clamp the difference between two image tensors so their Linf distance stays within a given radius
psnr_clip: clip an adversarial image so its PSNR against the original matches a target dB value
SSIMAttenuation_heatmap: compute an SSIM heatmap between two image tensors to measure structural similarity per region
SSIMAttenuation_apply: attenuate image perturbations using an SSIM heatmap to concentrate changes around high-detail zones
center_crop: perform a center crop on a PIL image to a target area scale
resize: resize a PIL image to dimensions derived from a target area scale
get_dataloader: create a PyTorch DataLoader from an ImageFolder directory with optional transform and batch size
pil_imgs_from_folder: load all images from a folder as PIL images and return them with their filenames
